CHAP.  X. — An Act to change the Times for holding Circuit and District Courts of the
United States for the western District of Virginia.
Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United
States of America in Congress assembled, That instead of the times now
fixed by law, the circuit and district courts of the United States for the
western district of Virginia shall hereafter be held as follows: At Dan-
ville, on the Tuesday after the fourth Monday of February and August;
at Lynchburg, on the Tuesday after the third Monday of March and
